receipts.name: Cordelia Ashmore-Vance
receipts.gift_message: Congratulations on your wedding! We hope you treasure this heron for years to come. - The Wellingtons

messages.subject: Board packet for the January meeting
messages.snippet: Amos - the January board packet is attached in the shared drive. Please review the preservation standards addendum before Wednesday.
messages.body:
Amos,

The January board packet is in the shared drive. Please review the preservation standards addendum from Malcolm before Wednesday's prep session, and flag anything you want moved to the consent agenda.

Cordelia

messages.subject: Order confirmed - white oak
messages.snippet: Your order is confirmed for Thursday pickup: 40 bf quartersawn white oak, freight on that lot billed separately.
messages.body:
Mr. Whitfield,

Your order is confirmed for Thursday pickup at the Savannah Building Supply yard: 40 board feet quartersawn white oak. Freight on that lot is billed through Ashcroft as usual. Nothing else is on this order.

Wesley Farraday

messages.subject: Quote - rock maple for the Windsor chairs
messages.snippet: Quote attached for the rock maple stock for the Renard-Whitcomb Windsor chairs. Kiln-dried, ready to ship from Charleston.
messages.body:
Amos,

Quote attached for the rock maple stock for the Renard-Whitcomb Windsor chairs - kiln-dried, ready to ship from Charleston next week. Say the word and I will hold the boards.

Ellis Marchand
Ashcroft Fine Hardwoods

messages.subject: Grant report due January 31
messages.snippet: Reminder: the restoration grant interim report is due January 31. Happy to review a draft the week before.
messages.body:
Amos,

A reminder that the restoration grant interim report is due January 31. If you send a draft the week before, I am happy to give it a read and flag anything the committee will ask about.

Roxanne Ellery
Georgia Trust

messages.subject: Deacons schedule for January
messages.snippet: January deacons rotation attached. You are down for the second and fourth Sundays.
messages.body:
Brother Amos,

The January deacons rotation is attached. You are down for the second and fourth Sundays. Let me know if the fourth conflicts with your workshop weekend.

Pastor Holloway

messages.subject: Sheraton sideboard - October delivery
messages.snippet: Checking in on the sideboard commission. October timing still holds on our end - no rush, just excited.
messages.body:
Mr. Whitfield,

Just checking in on the Sheraton sideboard commission. The October timing still holds on our end - no rush at all, we are just excited to see the dovetails.

The Barringtons

messages.subject: December financials ready for review
messages.snippet: December close is done. Statement of activities and the Bull Street repair actuals are in the finance folder.
messages.body:
Amos,

December close is done. The statement of activities and the Bull Street repair actuals are in the finance folder for your review before Reginald sees them Thursday.

Priscilla

drafts.subject: Re: Quote - rock maple for the Windsor chairs
drafts.body:
Ellis,

Quote looks fair. Hold the boards - I will confirm quantities after I re-measure the chair templates Saturday.

Amos
